verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents scoped API keys that grant only assigned Read or Write permissions on specific APIs instead of full account access, which is the core least-privilege credential an agent needs. The AgentOS MCP adds agent-specific guardrails, with OAuth and no money-out actions by default, and CLI OAuth is restricted to Owner, Admin and Finance Admin roles. Missing for 10: detailed docs on scope granularity, key expiry and rotation, user-selectable scopes for the agent OAuth flow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
